message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout, and let me tell you, my family group chat was buzzing! My daughter sent a picture of her flashlight collection, while my son declared he was ready to start a lantern art installation. I couldn’t help but chuckle at the creativity flowing, even in the dark. We shared tips on keeping our phones charged and what snacks we could still enjoy without power. It was a fun reminder that being prepared can spark some light-hearted moments too! Have you ever turned a blackout into an unexpected family bonding time?
